request: Deliver a feature with four values: customer submits order; cancels before payment; operator sees final status; duplicate payment notifications leave one payment.
outcomes: Orders can be submitted, cancelled before payment, observed and paid exactly once.

in_scope: Order submission, cancellation, status and payment notification.

decisions: Confirmed: the four values are delivered in dependency order.
The architect chooses the technical public command and state substrate; product intent above is the only fixed input.

values.observation: A customer submits an order and it is recorded as unpaid.
A customer cancels an unpaid order before payment is committed.

values.observation: An operator sees the final status of an order.
